analyst.summary: Power Mech Projects is a specialist contractor for thermal power plant construction and maintenance, benefiting from India's ongoing coal-capacity revival alongside its renewable buildout. Revenue and profit have both grown at a healthy mid-to-high-teens pace, debt has come down, and cash flow turned positive again after a working-capital-driven dip. We rate it a Hold: the sector tailwind and execution are both genuine, but this remains a cyclical, order-book-dependent EPC business rather than a structural compounder.
